outlook.statement: The Company remains committed to: 1. Strengthening its presence across traditional and digital media platforms to cater to evolving audience preferences. 2. Exploring diversified revenue opportunities, including advertising-led and digital monetization models. 3. Enhancing audience engagement through regional and relevant content offerings. 4. Leveraging technology, analytics and emerging AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency and content strategies. 5. Focusing on cost optimization, prudent financial management and sustainable long-term growth. 6. Continuously evaluating strategic collaborations and digital initiatives to remain competitive in the evolving media ecosystem.

The Indian media and entertainment industry is expected to continue its growth trajectory, supported by increasing digital adoption, expanding internet connectivity, rising demand for regional content, and technological innovation. Sea TV Network Limited remains focused on strengthening its core broadcasting business while exploring opportunities in broadband services, internet services, digital broadcasting, content creation, and other allied media businesses. The Company also intends to expand its operational footprint through strategic collaborations, business consolidation, and selective acquisitions wherever commercially viable.

The company have orders in hand as at 31st March 2026 for which performance obligation will be recognised as revenue during the next reporting year. The company have evaluated the position of orders in hand as on 31.03.2026 and do not expect any major/significant cancellation/reduction in order value as at the date of approval of the financial statements.
Management continues to implement measures to revive operations, control costs, and generate sufficient cash flows to meet its liabilities as they fall due.

The company is actively pursuing further restructuring or waiver of the unpaid interest on unsecured loans and expects a favourable outcome. Management continues to implement measures to revive operations, control costs, and generate sufficient cash flows to meet its liabilities as they fall due.

The company is quite hopeful that it would turn around in existing financial year and would safeguard the interest of all shareholders and stakeholders, accordingly the company do not foresee any type of capital risk in the future.

qualifications_or_emphasis: The Company has not provided for interest on unsecured loans amounting to ₹233.14 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

According to the Auditors, the non-recognition of interest expense is not in compliance with Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS) 109 – Financial Instruments, which requires financial liabilities to be measured at amortized cost using the effective interest method unless the interest obligation has been contractually waived.

Had the interest been recognized in accordance with Ind AS 109, the finance cost for the year would have been higher by ₹233.14 lakhs, the loss for the year would have increased by the same amount, and the current liabilities as at March 31, 2026 would have been higher by ₹233.14 lakhs.
